scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
^FF0000Chicken Eggs^000000! Come and
buy as many Chicken Eggs
as you want, whenever you
want! Hey buddy, you wanna
take a look at the Chicken
Eggs that I'm selling?
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
^FF0000鸡蛋^000000！随时欢迎前来购买，想买多少就买多少！嘿，巴迪，要不要看看我卖的鸡蛋？

scripts.text: What are you doing?
scripts.translation: 你在做什么？

scripts.text: Why Chicken Eggs?
scripts.translation: 为什么要买鸡蛋？

scripts.text: Sure, I'll buy some.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我买一些。

scripts.text: Never mind.
scripts.translation: 算了。

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
What am I--? I'm
selling Chicken Eggs!
For this special event
period, I'm selling as many
Chicken Eggs as you could
want for only 500 zeny each!
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
我是做什么的？我在卖鸡蛋啊！在这个特殊的活动期间，每个鸡蛋只要500泽尼，想买多少就买多少！

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Boys, girls, friends,
family, old people, young
people, um, maybe not most
vegetarians or raw foodists,
but almost everyone likes eggs!
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
男孩、女孩、朋友、家人、老人、年轻人……嗯，也许大多数素食主义者或生食主义者除外，但几乎所有人都喜欢鸡蛋！

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Can you imagine a world
without eggs? There'd be
no bread, pastries, cake
or frosting... Ice cream
would be a lot runnier...
Pranks wouldn't be as fun...
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
你能想象一个没有鸡蛋的世界吗？那就没有面包、糕点、蛋糕或糖霜了……冰淇淋会变得稀溜溜的……恶作剧也没那么有趣了……

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
I'm not really sure why, but
Chicken Eggs are popular
around this time of year.
They're hot items right
now, and I aim to cash in!
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
虽然我不太清楚原因，但每年这个时候鸡蛋都很受欢迎。现在可是抢手货，我正打算大赚一笔呢！

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Great! How many do you
want? Remember that each
Chicken Egg is 500 zeny.
Remember that you won't
always be able to buy
Chicken Eggs so easily!
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
太好了！你想要多少个？记住，每个鸡蛋是500泽尼。别忘了，可不是随时都能这么轻松地买到鸡蛋的哦！

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Hey, if you're not
going to buy anything,
then would you mind getting
out of the way so I can
help out my customers?
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
嘿，如果你不打算买东西，能不能让开一点，好让我服务其他顾客？

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Hey, you mind giving
me a real number? I also
can't sell you more than
1,000 Chicken Eggs at a time,
you know. C'mon, tell me how
many you want for real now.
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
嘿，能给我个确切的数字吗？另外，一次最多只能卖给你1,000个鸡蛋哦。来吧，认真告诉我你到底想要多少个。

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
You don't have enough Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
你的泽尼不够。

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
No discount, go and get enough Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
没有折扣，去凑够泽尼吧。

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Hey, I know you really
want to buy some Chicken
Eggs, but you won't be able
to carry that much now. Why
don't you free up some
Inventory space first?.
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
嘿，我知道你很想买些鸡蛋，但你现在的负重可带不了那么多。不如先清理一下物品栏的空间吧？

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Here's your Chicken Eggs!
I guess there's some festival
happening where you'll need
them, but I don't know anything
about that. Well, have a good
time, and I'll see you again!
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
这是你的鸡蛋！我想应该是有什么节日活动需要用到它们吧，不过我对那方面不太了解。好吧，祝你玩得开心，下次再见！

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Not interested in buying
Chicken Eggs, huh? Well,
word's going around that
there's some kind of festival
where they'll come in handy...
Can you really pass this up?
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
对买鸡蛋没兴趣吗？嗯，听说有个节日活动会派上用场……你真的要错过这个机会吗？

scripts.text:
[Dowdy Matron]
This festival is going
to be so much fun! Ooh!
I should buy some Chicken
Eggs to make some decorations.
scripts.translation:
[土气的主妇]
这个节日一定会非常有趣！噢！我应该买些鸡蛋来做些装饰品。

scripts.text:
[Dowdy Matron]
Speaking of which,
I've heard the nun that
can make Holy Eggs is back
in Prontera. Though, I think
she's using Chicken Eggs rather
than regular Eggs to make them.
scripts.translation:
[土气的主妇]
说到这个，我听说那位能制作圣蛋的修女回到普隆德拉了。不过，我觉得她是用鸡蛋而不是普通鸡蛋来制作的。

scripts.text:
[Cantankerous Geezer]
.Hey, do you know how
Chicken Eggs got to be so
expensive? I mean, 500 zeny
is a lot! I think it's because
some guy in Morocc is trying
to amass a ton of Holy Eggs!
scripts.translation:
[脾气古怪的老头]
嘿，你知道为什么鸡蛋变得这么贵吗？我是说，500泽尼可是不少钱！我想是因为梦罗克有个家伙正试图囤积大量的圣蛋！

scripts.text:
[Cantankerous Geezer]
I don't know what he's
offering for those Holy
Eggs, but adventurers are
coming to him with Holy Eggs
in droves. I wonder what he's
giving to them in return?
scripts.translation:
[脾气古怪的老头]
我不知道他拿什么交换那些圣蛋，但冒险者们正成群结队地带着圣蛋去找他。我想知道他给了他们什么作为回报？

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
Hello! If you'd like,
I can take your Chicken
Eggs and transform them
into Holy Eggs. It's something
I do for others in celebration
of this holy season.
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
你好！如果你愿意的话，我可以把你的鸡蛋转化成圣蛋。这是我为了庆祝这个神圣的季节而为他人提供的服务。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
Holy Eggs represent
rebirth and, fittingly,
can be used to restore
life to your friends.
Would you like me to
make some for you?
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
圣蛋象征着重生，恰如其分地，它可以用来恢复朋友的生命。你想让我为你制作一些吗？

scripts.text: What do I need to make Holy Eggs?
scripts.translation: 制作圣蛋需要什么？

scripts.text: I want to make Holy Eggs.
scripts.translation: 我想制作圣蛋。

scripts.text: Maybe next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再说。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
For each Holy Egg
that you want me to
make, you will need
to bring me...
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
每制作一个圣蛋，你需要给我带来……

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
^4D4DFF1 White Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Green Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Yellow Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Holy Water^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Chicken Egg^000000.
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
^4D4DFF1个白色药草^000000、
^4D4DFF1个绿色药草^000000、
^4D4DFF1个黄色药草^000000、
^4D4DFF1瓶圣水^000000，以及
^4D4DFF1个鸡蛋^000000。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
Alright, how many
Holy Eggs would you
like me to make you?
I can only make up to
10 Holy Eggs at a time.
Enter ''0'' to cancel.
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
好的，你想让我为你制作多少个圣蛋？我一次最多只能制作10个圣蛋。输入“0”取消。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
Oh, you changed your
mind? Feel free to visit me
whenever you want me to
make you some Holy Eggs~
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
噢，你改变主意了吗？随时欢迎你来找我制作圣蛋~

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
I'm sorry, but I can only
make up to 10 Holy Eggs
at a time. If you wanted to
cancel, then just enter ''0.''
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
抱歉，我一次最多只能制作10个圣蛋。如果你想取消，只需输入“0”。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough items to make
Holy Eggs. You need the
following for me to create
each Holy Egg for you.
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
抱歉，你没有足够的材料来制作圣蛋。每制作一个圣蛋，你需要提供以下物品。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
^4D4DFF1 White Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Green Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Yellow Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Holy Water^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Chicken Egg^000000.
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
^4D4DFF1个白色药草^000000、
^4D4DFF1个绿色药草^000000、
^4D4DFF1个黄色药草^000000、
^4D4DFF1瓶圣水^000000，以及
^4D4DFF1个鸡蛋^000000。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
I'm sorry, but you
won't be able to carry
that many Holy Eggs now...
You'd better free up more
space in your Inventory first.
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
抱歉，你现在无法携带那么多圣蛋……最好先清理一下物品栏的空间。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
Thank you!
I hope you enjoy
these Holy Eggs~
Hope you to be with God's love.
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
谢谢！
希望你喜欢这些圣蛋~
愿神的爱与你同在。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
Alright, I understand.
May God bless you.
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
好的，我明白了。
愿神保佑你。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
How are you doing?
Death... It's inescapable.
Even you'll die someday. But...
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
你好吗？死亡……是无法逃避的。总有一天你也会死去。但是……

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Oh, yes. That's it.
You have it. The egg you
hold has a secret power.
I think that... Yes. Someone
like you would understand
us, fit well into our group.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
噢，对了。就是它。你手里拿着的那个蛋拥有秘密的力量。我想……是的。像你这样的人会理解我们，很好地融入我们的团体。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Why don't
you... Join us?
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
为什么不……加入我们呢？

scripts.text: What for?
scripts.translation: 为了什么？

scripts.text: Um... But you're suspicious!
scripts.translation: 嗯……但你们很可疑！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
I see I've caught your
interest! Well, if you'd
like to join us and learn
more, then why don't you
bring me 10 Holy Eggs?
That is my condition.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
看来我引起了你的兴趣！好吧，如果你想加入我们并了解更多，那就给我带10个圣蛋来吧。这是我的条件。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Really? Well, I suppose
I can't help it. Let me
assure you that our
organization works
for the greater good.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
真的吗？好吧，我想我也没办法。让我向你保证，我们的组织是为了更大的利益而工作的。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
We should all enjoy
life while we still can.
Who knows? Perhaps
there will be other lives
to live after this one.
Perhaps, perhaps....
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
我们都应该趁还能享受的时候享受生活。谁知道呢？也许这一生之后还有其他生命可活。也许，也许……

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Ah, you have returned.
Did you still wish to
join our ranks? If so,
I hope you brought the
10 Holy Eggs I require.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
啊，你回来了。你还想加入我们的行列吗？如果是的话，希望你带来了我所要求的10个圣蛋。

scripts.text: Give Holy Eggs
scripts.translation: 给予圣蛋

scripts.text: Don't Give Holy Eggs
scripts.translation: 不给予圣蛋

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
So you do wish to
join our organization.
First, let me check if you
brought the Holy Eggs...
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
所以你的确想加入我们的组织。首先，让我检查一下你是否带来了圣蛋……

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Very well. In return
for these Holy Eggs, let
me give you a small present
for joining us. Now, I can
tell you about what we do.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
很好。作为这些圣蛋的回报，让我给你一份加入我们要的小礼物。现在，我可以告诉你我们是做什么的了。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
^333333*Cough Cough*^000000
Excuse me, I've got--
^333333*Cough!*^000000 A... A bit of a
sore throat. Give me a sec...

[Corps Member]
Hm. You don't have enough
Holy Eggs to meet the condition
I set for you. Did you leave
them in your Storage?
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
嗯。你的圣蛋数量不足以满足我设定的条件。你是不是把它们留在仓库里了？

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Hm? I suppose I can't
blame you for being a bit
suspicious of us. Let me
assure you that ours is
a mission of holiness.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
嗯？我想我不能怪你对我们有点怀疑。让我向你保证，我们的使命是神圣的。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
We are an organization
that is dedicated to...
Resurrecting dead heroes!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
我们是一个致力于……复活已故英雄的组织！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Those Holy Eggs that you've
brought have the power to
restore life to the dead.
In large quantities...
They can even revive
ancient fallen heroes!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
你带来的那些圣蛋拥有让死者复生的力量。大量使用的话……它们甚至可以复活古代陨落的英雄！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
When you bring me
33 Holy Eggs, I will
enchant them so that you
can use them on areas where
ancient heroes had died.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
当你给我带来33个圣蛋时，我会为它们附魔，以便你可以在古代英雄陨落的地方使用它们。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Go and bring me
33 Holy Eggs! I shall be
waiting here for your return...
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
去给我带33个圣蛋来！我将在这里等待你的归来……

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Ah, you've returned
Now, did you bring me
33 Holy Eggs for your task?
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
啊，你回来了。现在，你为我任务所需的33个圣蛋带来了吗？

scripts.text: Give Holy Eggs
scripts.translation: 给予圣蛋

scripts.text: Don't Give Holy Eggs
scripts.translation: 不给予圣蛋

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Ah, these will do!
Now, make a note of the
destination I describe as
I infuse these Holy Eggs
with additional magic.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
啊，这些可以了！现在，在我为这些圣蛋注入额外魔法时，记下我描述的目的地。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
You must go to the
entrance of Payon Dungeon,
where a nimble hero has fallen.
Sacrifice the Holy Eggs there,
and then return to me. Now...
Go, and bring him back to life!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
你必须前往斐扬地下城的入口，那里有一位敏捷的英雄陨落了。在那里献祭圣蛋，然后回到我这里。现在……去吧，让他复活！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Go to the 3rd level of
Izlude dungeon... A hero.
that sought wisdom perished
at the entrance to the 4th
level. Sacrifice the Holy Eggs
there, and return him to life!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
前往依斯鲁得岛地下城的第3层……一位寻求智慧的英雄在第4层的入口处丧生。在那里献祭圣蛋，让他复活！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Go to the abandoned mine
dungeon where a brave hero
died to protect his comrades.
Sacrifice the Holy Eggs as soon
as you get to the 3rd floor.
Go, and bring him back to life!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
前往废弃矿坑地下城，那里有一位勇敢的英雄为了保护同伴而死。一到第3层就献祭圣蛋。去吧，让他复活！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Go to Glastheim, and
sacrifice the Holy Eggs
as soon as you enter the
2nd floor. A hero perished
there, but you shall bring
him back to the living!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
前往格拉斯特海姆，一进入第2层就献祭圣蛋。一位英雄在那里陨落，但你将把他带回人间！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Hm? This isn't
33 Holy Eggs. Did you
leave some in your Storage?
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
嗯？这不是33个圣蛋。你是不是把一些留在仓库里了？

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Don't you understand
the righteousness of
our cause? Returning fallen
heroes will bring peace to
our lands much more quickly!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
你不明白我们事业的正义性吗？复活陨落的英雄将更快地为我们的土地带来和平！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Did you forget
where you must go?
Let me remind you
so that you do not
lose your way...
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
你忘了必须去哪里吗？让我提醒你，以免你迷路……

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
[Corps Member]
You must go to the
entrance of Payon Dungeon,
where a nimble hero has fallen.
Sacrifice the Holy Eggs there,
and then return to me. Now...
Go, and bring him back to life!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
[军团成员]
你必须前往斐扬地下城的入口，那里有一位敏捷的英雄陨落了。在那里献祭圣蛋，然后回到我这里。现在……去吧，让他复活！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
[Corps Member]
Go to the 3rd level of
Izlude dungeon... A hero.
that sought wisdom perished
at the entrance to the 4th
level. Sacrifice the Holy Eggs
there, and return him to life!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
[军团成员]
前往依斯鲁得岛地下城的第3层……一位寻求智慧的英雄在第4层的入口处丧生。在那里献祭圣蛋，让他复活！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
[Corps Member]
Go to the abandoned mine
dungeon where a brave hero
died to protect his comrades.
Sacrifice the Holy Eggs as soon
as you get to the 3rd floor.
Go, and bring him back to life!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
[军团成员]
前往废弃矿坑地下城，那里有一位勇敢的英雄为了保护同伴而死。一到第3层就献祭圣蛋。去吧，让他复活！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Go to Glastheim, and
sacrifice the Holy Eggs
as soon as you enter the
2nd floor. A hero perished
there, but you shall bring
him back to the living!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
前往格拉斯特海姆，一进入第2层就献祭圣蛋。一位英雄在那里陨落，但你将把他带回人间！

scripts.text: [Corps Member]
scripts.translation: [军团成员]

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Ah, I hope you've come
back with good news.
So did it work?
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
啊，我希望你带着好消息回来了。成功了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually...
Nothing happened....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
实际上……
什么也没发生……

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
What? It can't be.
The magic... It should
have been powerful enough...
Well, it's too bad that we
failed. Even so, I am grateful
for all your help thus far...
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
什么？不可能。魔法……应该足够强大才对……唉，真遗憾我们失败了。尽管如此，我还是感谢你迄今为止的所有帮助……

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
We'll investigate what
could have gone wrong,
and then try again next year.
Farewell, my friend, and I hope
that you'll assist us again.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
我们会调查哪里出了错，然后明年再试一次。再见，我的朋友，希望你能再次协助我们。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Shh! Tell no one
that I am here.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
嘘！不要告诉任何人我在这里。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well...
This is the place
the Corps Member
wanted me to find...
Time to use all of
these Holy Eggs.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯……
这就是军团成员
让我找的地方……
是时候使用所有
这些圣蛋了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here we go...
Will this really bring
this ancient hero
back to life? I'm...
I'm kind of scared!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
开始了……
这真的能让这位古代英雄
复活吗？我……
我有点害怕！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333*Whew!*^000000 Nothing happened!
I guess I better go back to
that Corps Member and let
him know that it didn't work.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^333333*呼！*^000000什么也没发生！
我想我最好回去找那个军团成员，
告诉他这没用。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh? Where did I put
those 33 Holy Eggs
that I needed for this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？我把做这件事所需的
33个圣蛋放哪儿了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There was something
here, but I can't tell
for sure what it was...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这里好像有什么东西，
但我不确定那是什么……
